essence: The blue mountain Nīlācala consists of two parts and possesses cat's-eye radiance.
Beginning from the east, the described extent is arranged into thirty-two parts.
Mālyavān is located in the western part and is black in color.
This thirty-two-part black region is named Gandhamādana.
The single middle part should be a white square.
